may-learn-inbox-handle-recovered-timeout.rationale: A recovered transient failure needs an internal record, not another human interruption.

may-learn-inbox-route-product-failure.rationale: The accountable project owner must investigate and attempt recovery before asking Hao.

may-learn-inbox-return-vague-cleanup.rationale: A producer must supply bounded scope and current proof before requesting a decision.

may-learn-inbox-deliver-gym-decision.rationale: A proven preference-sensitive evaluation change is a real human decision and needs a complete packet.

may-learn-inbox-reject-secret-request.rationale: Telegram must never request a secret; the secure owner surface handles credential work.

may-learn-inbox-suppress-duplicate-pr.rationale: A changed run id does not make the same open pull request a new human decision.

may-learn-inbox-deliver-useful-digest.rationale: A requested compact digest remains useful and should survive attention filtering.
